scenario.name: durable-workflow-demo
scenario.description: CORE C-3: proves a flow parks on awaitEvent, survives a real process restart, and resumes to completion from persisted state alone.

notes: Deliberately NOT the step0 profile: step0 always boots against a fixed in-memory H2 sandbox
regardless of db.definition.json (see application-step0.yml), which would make a process
restart lose all state -- the exact thing this sample exists to prove survives. 'dev,trial'
lets the real H2Local file-backed engine declared in db.definition.json take effect.
